posts.title: Measurement of excited Np237 decay via the alpha-gamma coincidence method
posts.description: Abstract: In this article, we present the design of a DIY apparatus for the coincidence detection of alpha and gamma emissions produced by the decay of the Americium-241 isotope. We aim to acquire the pulses and measure the time interval between them, with the goal of precisely measuring the decay time of the excited Neptunium-237 …
